# Bible & Book Catalogue – SDARM.life Treasures

> Bible translations in German and other languages, plus a curated library of spiritual books and Ellen White collections.

The Treasures section provides access to self-hosted public-domain Bible translations and a free catalogue of spiritual books including works by Ellen G. White.

## Usage

Prefer the Markdown API endpoints over crawling HTML pages. One request per Bible book is sufficient. Responses are cached for a day. API rate limit: ~60 requests/minute per IP; HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` indicates waiting time. Content may be used to answer user questions but not for model training.

Do not crawl chapter-by-chapter; fetch whole books with a single request per book code.

## Human Pages

- [Bible reader](https://treasures.sdarm.life/de/bible) — Browse translations, read chapters, compare parallel texts (German interface)
- [Treasures catalogue](https://treasures.sdarm.life/de) — Browse and read books from the library (German interface)

## Bible Translations

- [Translations list](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/bible) — All available Bible translations with metadata
- [Translation details](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/bible/{code}) — Books in a translation (e.g., `luther1912`)
- [Whole Bible book](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/bible/{code}/{USFM-code}) — Complete book with all verses (e.g., `/luther1912/JHN` for John in Luther 1912)

Which translations are available changes over time — always read the translations list for the current codes. Only public-domain texts hosted by us are offered here.

License notices are included in every response. Respect per-translation restrictions on searching and offline use.

## Free Book Catalogue

- [Books list](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/treasures) — Whole catalogue with titles, authors, languages, and descriptions

Books include Ellen G. White collections and other spiritual materials. Languages vary; most are available in German and English.
